This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Veggie Rice Balls are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with [[Hylian Rice]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. [[Link]] can make their default version either by using [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which offer no [[Added Effect]]s, or by using multiple [[Ingredient]]s with contradicting Effects. Eating them will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s. These dishes originate from [[Kakariko Village]] and are stuffed with many Ingredients found in the mountains. Several different variations of Veggie Rice Balls can be made, depending on the type of Vegetable, herb, or Flower used: * '''Hearty Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Veggie Rice Balls}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. Link can eat them to heal all of his Hearts and will gain temporary Hearts. * '''Energizing Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Veggie Rice Balls}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. When eaten, Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be partially refilled. * '''Enduring Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Veggie Rice Balls}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Consuming these rice balls will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. They can be eaten to boost Link's movement speed. * '''Spicy Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electric Ingredients. One level of [[Shock Resistance]] will be given to Link when he eats these meals. * '''Mighty Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other mighty Ingredients. By eating them, Link's attack power will be boosted. * '''Tough Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, [[Armoranth]]s, or other tough Ingredients. Link's defense will be increased when he eats them. * '''Sneaky Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. If consumed, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Veggie Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Veggie Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This home-style dish of Kakariko Village is stuffed with the bounty of the mountains.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Link can eat these rice balls to gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, the [[Recipe]] for Veggie Rice Balls in {{TotK}} involves [[Cooking]] a bundle of [[Hylian Rice]] with any type of [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Veggie Rice Balls is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Destroy the Yiga Clan!]]". It is made using four [[Blue Nightshade]]s and four [[Hylian Rice]]. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to three. [[Cooking]] Veggie Rice Balls before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of damage dealt using [[Sheikah Rune]]s by 35 percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Veggie Rice Balls Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Veggie Rice Balls icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Vegetable Risotto }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Rice Balls |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
